stemMd: Choose the correct verb: "The box of old negatives ___ on the highest shelf."
explanationMd: Find the head of the subject: box. "Of old negatives" only describes the box; the singular subject takes "rests."

distractorRationale.d: The singular subject box requires rests.
distractorRationale.b: The verb wrongly agrees with negatives inside the of phrase.
distractorRationale.a: The plural auxiliary does not agree with box.
